text: The silence of the battlefield had been replaced by the chaotic noise of celebration. From the vantage point of a soldier returning to the village, the scene was overwhelming. I watched as neighbors embraced, their faces streaked with tears that were no longer born of fear but of profound relief. The war, which had stretched on for so long, was finally a memory. As I stepped off the transport, I knew that the men and women we had left behind were now safe, and the long wait for their return was ending. The Nile is the longest river in the world.
